meta.title: Gudauri Mountain Apartment — Summer Rentals
meta.description: A comfortable apartment in Gudauri, Georgia. Cool mountain air and direct access to Caucasus hiking trails. Book your summer stay.

hero.headline: Your summer base in the Georgian mountains
hero.subheadline: Cool air. Mountain trails. A comfortable apartment in Gudauri — away from the heat, closer to what matters.

gallery.title: The space
gallery.subtitle: A clean, comfortable apartment with everything you need to work and unwind.

why.title: Why this place
why.subtitle: Built for proper rest and mountain living.

blocks.title: Mountain views
blocks.description: Wake up to the Greater Caucasus range. The apartment faces the mountains — no obstruction, no noise.

blocks.title: Summer trails
blocks.description: Step outside and you're minutes from alpine meadows, ridge hikes, and unmarked paths. No car needed for day trips.

blocks.title: Cooler than the city
blocks.description: At 2,200 m elevation, Gudauri stays 10–15°C cooler than Tbilisi all summer. Sleep with the windows open.

blocks.title: Easy access
blocks.description: Two hours from Tbilisi on the Georgian Military Highway. Regular marshrutkas or a simple drive through the mountains.

location.title: Getting there
location.subtitle: Gudauri sits on the Georgian Military Highway, one of the most scenic routes in the Caucasus.
location.from_tbilisi_detail: 2 hours by car (120 km) on a well-paved highway. Marshrutkas (minibuses) depart from Didube station daily.
location.from_airport_detail: 2.5 hours by car. We can help arrange a transfer.
location.altitude_detail: 2,200 m above sea level. Summer temperatures: 15–25°C during the day.
location.groceries_detail: Small shops in the village. For a full stock-up, stop in Gudauri or Stepantsminda on the way.

items.q: What time is check-in and check-out?
items.a: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 11:00. Flexible timing can be arranged if the apartment is free.

items.q: Is it cold at night in summer?
items.a: Evenings drop to 8–12°C. The apartment has central heating and extra blankets. Bring a light jacket for outside.
There are small shops in Gudauri village. For a bigger selection, stop at a supermarket in Pasanauri or Tbilisi on the way up.

items.q: How do I get the keys?
items.a: We use a key lockbox for self check-in. You'll receive the code and detailed instructions by email before arrival.
Yes, free parking is available right at the building. No reservation needed.
